pairs.why: A's teal saucer turns into a darker shadow side with a deeper rim, like the real cards' soft but saturated form shading, while B's silver top is washed out and flat.
A has a darker interior, a clear shadow side on the locker's left face and a firm cast shadow, close to the real locker's soft gradient and grounding, while B is flatter and paler.
A shows a bit more side-to-side form turn on the pump body and a heavier contact shadow on the slab, while B is smoother and flatter.
Both clocks have the same glossy upper-left rim highlight and a faint wall shadow, unlike the real card's soft rim gradient and clear drop shadow, so my vector gives no reason to choose.
B's gloves have broad soft sheen and smooth form turn like the real gloves, while A has sharper speckled hot spots and a more glossy-plastic look.
A has one clean highlight and a smooth gradient like the real glass cup, while B's airbrushed internal swirl and rim glow are not how the real cards model form.
A has a visible light-to-dark turn across the barrel and a rim on the front ring like the real lamp, while B is tiny and its shading barely reads.
A has more form modeling on the fabric and tubes plus a strong cast shadow on the floor, closer to the real chair's dramatic soft shading than B's thin, flat frame.
